revision.refused: No changes committed. Larger-y-first pickup priority contradicts earlier recordings that choose smaller-y targets first, including within the same image column. No color-based or other general priority is supported. Recording the future pickup order would make memory unpredictable from the reveal observations, and treating serialization order as pickup priority would undo earlier corrections. The existing memory correctly retains both eligible targets and permits either to be selected. Exact recorded-object prediction remains unresolved and requires an independently specified pickup priority or evaluation accepting any eligible remaining target; it cannot be settled by a supported edit on this evidence.
